head: ClipReel: AI video editor in your browser that edits by chat
dek: ClipReel is a new browser video editor where you type the edit you want, such as a trim, captions or a vertical crop, see a preview and then add it to the timeline. You can try it without an account, and paid plans start at $49 a month.
details: It also does speed ramps, split screens, masks, text behind a person, silence removal and remixes of a shot's light or setting, and you can still fine-tune on a normal timeline. Exports go up to 1080p, as MP4 or WebM, without a watermark. Plans: Starter $49, Creator $69 and Studio $99 a month (less when paid yearly), with 300 to 1,000 chat edits and 110 to 180 video credits a month. It was featured on BetaList on 23 November; an account saves projects online so you can open them on another device.
where: Web browser; free to try, plans from $49 a month
means: If you cut short videos for Reels, TikTok or Shorts, you can describe the edit instead of doing every step by hand.
todo: Open the sample project first to see how the chat edits work before you upload your own footage or pick a plan.
